Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 15 s. 2023 MAR 15 2023 DIR. JUAN JOVIAN E. INGENIERO Regional Director, DILG Region-VI P. Aquino St., Fort San Pedro Iloilo City Dear RD Ingeniero: This has reference to your Memorandum dated October IO, 2022 requesting for Central Office's guidance on the recently issued Legal Opinion (LO) Nos. 71, s.20221 and 110, s.20222. In LO No. 71 , s.2022, the Department has opined that Rule IV of COMELEC-DILG-NYC Joint Memorandum Circular No. 2017-013 shall apply to fill up the vacancies in the position of SK Pederasyon President and Vice-President. In LO No. 1 IO, s.2022, the position of the Department is that the concurrent vacancies in the offices of the President and Vice President of the Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan shall be governed by the Internal Rules of Procedure of the concerned SK Pederasyon, pursuant to Item V, Section 23(1)(2) of the subject JMC, viz: "Formulate and adopt its own Internal Rules of Procedures (IRP) which shall prescribe a set of rules to serve as guidelines of the Pederasyon Officers and the Committees in the discharge of their official functions, duties and responsibilities, particularly on internal organization; date, time and venueof regular or special session meeting, parliamentary procedures; payment of pederasyon dues and such other rules and regulations that may be adopted by the pederasyon that are not contrary to existing laws, ordinance, this JMC and other government issuances". On the other hand, the NYC has opined that Section 41(a)(4) finds application in the case. They added that the subject JMC provides no option to directly elect the President of the Pederasyon. Thus, upon election of the Vice President in a special election, the elected VP shall then automatically assume the office for the unexpired portion of the term. Hence, in so far as the vacated VP position is concerned, Section 42 of the JMC shall be applied, which provides: "Vacancies in other position shall be filled up through an appointment by the 1 Dated July 29, 2022 2 Dated October 3, 2022 3 Entitled, "GUIDELINES ON THE CONDUCT OF SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN (SK) PEDERASYON ELECTION; AND RULES GOVERNING TERMS OF OFFICE, SUSPENSION AND REMOVAL OF ALL SK PEDERASYON OFFICERS" "Matino, Mahusay at Maasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

Pederasyon President upon concurrence of the majority of all the Pederasyon officers. " These opinions were based on the fact that the current Municipal SK Federation President of Sibalom, Antique was elected as Sangguniang Bayan Member during the May 9, 2022 elections. Along with this was the information that the SK Federation Vice President passed away last January 2020. Although it is silent as to whether the position of Vice President was filled up as a result of its permanent vacancy last January 2020, it can be inferred that there was no filling up. Meanwhile, DILG Memorandum Circular No. 2022-130 was issued on October 6, 2022, with subject: "MANNER OF FILLING UP OF VACANCY IN THE BARANGAY, SANGGUNIANG KABATAAN (SK), LIGA NG MGA BARANGAY AND PEDERASYON NG MGA SK DUE TO THE ASSUMPTION TO HIGHER POSITION/OFFICE OF BSKOs WHO WON IN THE MAY 09, 2022 NA TIONAL AND LOCAL ELECTIONS". Considering the issuance of Memorandum Circular No. 2022-130, LOS inconsistent therewith are superseded by this Memorandum Circular. The manner of filling up vacancies both in the offices of the President and Vice President of the Pederasyon ng mga Sangguniang Kabataan, as provided in MC No. 2022-130 shall be through the conduct of Special Election from among the other officers of the Pederasyon. The procedures or steps in the conduct of Special Election shall be governed by the Internal Rules of Procedures of the concerned SK Pederasyon. We hope to have finally settled this matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BYA THORITY OF THE S RETARY: . JUA ICTOR R. LLAMAS ersecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs OUSELLNJVRULRALLD/rrao
